en.headline: Tai Kwun stages FRAMED Halloween nights in Central later this week
en.dek: The heritage compound will host free art-inspired costume events in the Prison Yard on 30 and 31 October from 7pm to 10pm.
body: Tai Kwun will hold its FRAMED Halloween experience on 30 and 31 October, turning the Prison Yard into a living gallery with light installations and empty frames.
Visitors are invited to wear art-inspired costumes and become part of the display against the former prison's architecture. The event is free, according to the organisers.

Those registered as TK FAN who arrive in costume can scan a code in the app for a complimentary first drink voucher at 1862 Bar de Tapas y Vino while stocks last. A bar-hopping map will also be available for the evening.

zh.headline: 大館下周舉行FRAMED藝裝萬聖夜
zh.dek: 中環大館將於10月30及31日晚上7時至10時在監獄操場免費舉辦藝術服裝主題活動，邀請訪客化身活藝術品。
body: 大館將於本月30及31日舉辦FRAMED藝裝萬聖夜，把監獄操場變成活畫廊，配合燈光裝置及空畫框。
主辦方邀請訪客穿上受藝術啟發的服裝，融入前監獄建築環境中成為展品一部分。活動免費入場。
穿服裝並登記為TK FAN的訪客，可於應用程式掃碼換取1862酒吧第一杯免費飲品，數量有限，先到先得。場內亦提供酒吧巡遊地圖。
